chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Import under Lease Financing

business_rules.rule_description:
2.31 Import under Lease Financing
Import under lease financing shall be available under EOU/ SEZ scheme.
business_rules.condition:
Domestic
supply of capital goods to eligible categories of deemed exports shall be eligible for
benefits of deemed export as in paragraph 7.03 of FTP, even in cases where supplies
are under lease financing
business_rules.validation:
2.31 Import under Lease Financing
Import under lease financing shall be available under EOU/ SEZ scheme.
business_rules.exception: No explicit exception found in uploaded documents.
business_rules.output: DEKAI should produce a compliance decision for 2.31 - Import under Lease Financing.
